label: Race session data loader

dataclass_fields_present.detail: All 16 required fields present on RaceStintData frozen dataclass: year, gp, driver, stint_num, compound, lap_nums, tyre_life, processed_df, mass_kg, cumulative_track_laps, rho, n_race_laps, n_clean_laps, tyre_life_start, tyre_life_end, sparse. Test confirms at line 193.

tyre_life_absolute_not_normalized.detail: No subtraction of min from tyre_life anywhere in session_race.py. final_tyre_life = tyre_life_arr (raw numpy from lap_times). Comment at lines 14-15 and 101-103 documents VER Bahrain 2023 starts at 4. Test test_tyre_life_is_absolute verifies [4,5] not [0,1].

track_statuses_never_none.detail: race_mass is always called with track_statuses=all_track_statuses (line 610). all_track_statuses is always a populated list (lines 488-490 fill missing entries with '1' fallback). No code path passes track_statuses=None to race_mass. Spy test (test_track_statuses_never_none) confirms this at runtime.

cumulative_track_laps_definition.detail: compute_cumulative_track_laps uses COUNT(*) WHERE lap_number < first_clean_lap_num (line 239), counting all driver-lap pairs regardless of valid_lap or track_status. Tests confirm 0 for lap 1, 100 for 20 drivers x 5 laps, and non-clean laps are included.

no_existing_files_modified.detail: git diff HEAD~1 HEAD --name-only returns exactly 2 files: src/physics/layer2/session_race.py and tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_session_race.py. __init__.py was not touched. Excluded files (session_fit.py, estimate_store.py, session_estimator.py, mass_model.py) all clean.

tests_31_pass.detail: py -m pytest tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_session_race.py -v → 31 passed in 0.56s. All 31 collected, 0 failed, 0 errors.

forbidden_imports_absent.detail: Grep for evo_predictor, latent_power, compound_prior, fastf1, 'import fastf1', 'from fastf1' in session_race.py returns only a docstring comment (line 17), no actual import statements.

no_direct_fastf1_calls.detail: Data exclusively from SQLite (lap_times table) via sqlite3 + pandas read_sql_query, and TelemetryStore (Parquet mirror). No fastf1 import or direct FastF1 API call in session_race.py.

n_race_laps_definition.detail: n_race_laps = _get_n_race_laps uses SELECT MAX(lap_number) FROM lap_times WHERE session_id=? (line 197). Test test_n_race_laps_is_max_lap_number confirms 57 when VER goes 57 laps and HAM goes 50.

init_py_scope.detail: src/physics/layer2/__init__.py has zero diff in HEAD commit. Scope constraint respected.

out_of_scope_observations.detail: Handoff stated 286 lines / 481 lines for the two files. Actual commit is 634 / 817 lines. The implementation is more complete (handles URI fallback, smoother HP calibration, per-lap fitting, rho from weather) than the headline implied. This is not a defect — larger scope is richer, all tests still pass.

out_of_scope_observations.item: _is_clean helper defined but unused in main path
out_of_scope_observations.detail: The _is_clean row-wise function at lines 283-290 is defined but the main load_race_stints uses a vectorized clean_mask (lines 503-508) instead. This is dead code. Not a bug — both approaches are equivalent. Worth a cleanup note for g3.

out_of_scope_observations.item: Smoother calibration falls back gracefully on empty window list
out_of_scope_observations.detail: If no valid tele laps found for a driver, _fit_driver_laps returns {} and processed_df is a minimal lap_number-only frame. This is documented in the docstring and the column contract (lap_number always present). Acceptable per-spec.

When a lap's track_status is missing from driver_laps_df, the code fills it with '1' (line 490). This is a conservative assumption (green flag = full fuel burn) which may slightly overestimate mass for laps where VER didn't start. Acceptable for a data loader; the gap-fill policy could be documented.

workflow_feedback: Commit message is accurate and concise. Co-author line present.
Test coverage is thorough: frozen dataclass, all field values, hard-gate spy, rho fallback, import contract. 31 tests at 0.56s is fast.
The handoff line count estimates (286/481) were significantly off from reality (634/817). Future handoffs should use 'git show --stat' actuals.
